Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support prices despite extended levels.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand and monetary premium drive a structural deficit.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate market and green energy transition offset weak Chinese property demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear build-out support strong upside.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV demand growth weigh heavily on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply growth and LFP battery substitution pressure prices.

Zinc.note: Significant mine supply disruptions and tight treatment charges support a bullish outlook.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and elevated port inventories cap upside potential.

Coal.note: Structural decline in thermal coal demand offsets steady metallurgical coal pricing.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls and weak EV motor demand create near-term pricing uncertainty.

Manganese.note: Steady global steel demand balances against intermittent South African logistical constraints.

PGM.note: Hydrogen economy potential and constrained South African supply support a modest premium.

Potash.note: Normalizing supply from Eastern Europe offsets steady but unspectacular agricultural demand.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong green transition demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Mixed signals between strong copper demand and weak iron ore prices result in a neutral outlook.
